notes.title: Early Acce2s A1PHA v1.13 - EXPANDED DEMO - ACT 1
notes.content:
[h1]2121 DEVELOPMENT UPDATE 2121[/h1]

Greetings Seekers,

The entirety of Act 1 has just been made available for everyone to play via the free demo. At this time, we would like to make a few things perfectly clear: 

[list]
[*]Consortium: THE TOWER is officially in “Development Hell”. This means that for a variety of reasons, development is currently paused. The project is NOT cancelled. If you wish to support development of Consortium: THE TOWER, the best way is to wish-list the game, buy any of our other games and/or support us via Patreon (search the internet for "patreon idgi1")
[*]The absolute latest version of THE TOWER shares the Unreal Engine 4.27 code-base that represents the completed and released CONSORTIUM VR/Remastered(PC/Meta Quest). This means that all features and improvements found in that title will be coming to THE TOWER in a future “Alpha 2.0” release, including full VR support.
[*]Our 2016 crowdfunding Fig campaign made the existence of this game possible. All funds raised were used for development of THE TOWER. We simply cannot stress this enough: without the campaign, there would be no Consortium: THE TOWER game whatsoever. HOWEVER, we wholly acknowledge that we owe all backers, investors and buyers of this game on Steam a finished game, and we remain steadfastly determined to make that happen. No matter how long it takes.
[/list]
We have amended the "Why Early Access" section of the store page to make it very clear that we don't want anyone else buying the game at this time, and that everyone should instead play the free EXPANDED DEMO of THE TOWER Alpha 1.13.

[h1]v1.13 RELEASE NOTES[/h1]

-More preview areas of Act 2 have been unlocked - it is technically possible to get deep under The Churchill Tower, now.
-Demo now includes the entirety of a modified Act 1 of Consortium: THE TOWER. 
-Demo now supports importing saved games from CONSORTIUM Remastered/VR.
-Was forced to disable the “Universe Log” system entirely for this build - it was too rotten, unfinished and not particularly useful anyways. This will make a return in Alpha 2.0 using CONSORTIUM VR/Remastered’s implementation.
-General optimizations made to reduce “draw calls” in many areas - game will perform better in certain areas on lower end machines.
-The automated missile hot-slot device can now be found…
-”Frank McFrankie” encounter on the roof - now has a significantly improved voice. Casting is still not final. 
-The “loot stash” on the roof has more stuff in it.
-There is now an entirely new and secret way to go directly from the roof to the hotel park
-There are now many turrets defending the hotel helicopter pad entrance to the hotel park.
-Removed turret inside vent maze that is just after the “Malcolm trap”
-More resources can now be found all over the place. (recyclables, ammo, weapons and armor).
-The Hotel Park layout has been significantly modified to help “funnel” players towards an encounter with “The Voice”. 
-The Hotel room floors (in-between the Hotel Lobby and Park) are now only directly accessible with the key found on the roof. The area can still be accessed via the Water Tunnels, however. 
-The “Water Tunnels” access spot in the Hotel Rooms has been cleared out significantly, making it significantly easier to find.
-The encounter with Frank McFrankie that could be discovered in the Water tunnels is no longer accessible at this time.
-The connection between the “Water Tunnels” and the industrial Churchill Tower “side vents” is now fully accessible in Act 1 and has been given a significant “environmental accuracy” pass
-The Hotel Lobby has been given a major “environmental accuracy” pass - the entire main lobby interior has been cleared of erreoneous geometry and is now opened up, effectively making encountering Preben Skogan much easier/faster to accomplish.

KNOWN ISSUES:
-This build is still old and definitely has problems, including major A.I related bugs and issues. This patch does NOT fix all known issues. However, it should be very stable.
-The early prototype version of V.O.I.C.E. is in this build, but it definitely has issues and may not work correctly anymore. Alpha 2.0 will use V.O.I.C.E v1.0 that is used for CONSORTIUM Remastered/VR.
-The Information Console found in this stream is very inaccurate and incomplete. We instead recommend using the FREE information console app that can be downloaded via itch.io:  ( https://idgi.itch.io/consortium-info-console ) 

[h1]WHAT'S NEXT[/h1]

We realize that we have lost many of you folks who bought our game years ago (all of the "reviews" telling folks the project is dead/abandoned/etc kind of gave it away...). Many of you rightfully feel like we've let you down. We truly do deeply apologize for this. This is a brutal time in the game industry, and to be perfectly honest, right now, we are mostly focusing on projects that are helping us survive this industry nightmare.

We find it interesting that despite technically how old Consortium: THE TOWER Alpha may be now, there is still no other experience quite like it. It is for this reason that we remain resolute that the completed game will be worth the wait!

We're gonna get Alpha 2.0 done and out to you all as soon as we can bring Consortium: THE TOWER out of "Development Hell", at which point we will be on a steady path towards completion. 

In the meantime...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30435651/e59a2b491207ca6f893e1aae24f3a94f0dad5d0d.png[/img]

We have other irons in the fire, including and especially....the interactive novel prequel to both Consortium games:  WHISPERS FROM THE RIFT. Whispers is actively being given a final coat of polish by Steve right now, and we will FINALLY be officially announcing the release date very shortly...

With grace, sincerity and love for each and every one of you who have enjoyed our experiences over the years...

Namaste,
- iDGi

notes.title: Consortium: THE TOWER Ear1y Acce2s ALPHA v1.12
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Seekers,[/h2]

Other than (potentially) one more patch, this will be the final build of Consortium: THE TOWER that uses the UE4.15 engine. The TOWER project at large has long since been moved up to UE4.27 to co-exist with CONSORTIUM VR/Remastered and now shares many heavily updated resources, such as choreo systems, user interface,  game mechanics, AI, a brand new save/load system and more. 

This updated UE4.27 version of Consortium: THE TOWER is not yet playable yet but when it is ready, it will be coming as “Alpha v2.0”. 

SPECIAL NOTE to all CONSORTIUM Remastered / VR players that are interested in continuing their story. We do not recommend proceeding too far past the rooftop of THE TOWER in general, if you do decide to buy and play right now. The roof is indicative of a finished part of the game, but everywhere is in various states of deep incompletion and bugginess.

ALPHA v1.12 of Consortium: THE TOWER fully supports importing Universes from CONSORTIUM VR / Remastered.  We also made a few other changes. Because it has been so long since we’ve updated this for you all, we have decided to open up more of what iDGi-1 has managed to map out of the Churchill Tower - seekers can theoretically get as far down as the parking garage now, though it is exceedingly cold and hazardous.

CAUTION:  The iDGi-1 signal strength is still very low for most of these new lower Tower areas (though we have forcibly filtered out the visual distortion so that it is possible to navigate these “proto-areas”). Only the most stalwart and determined seeker is invited to go down there…save spheres are rare.  

NOTE: Just in case, the old December 2019 build of Alpha 1.11 can still be accessed by opting into the “alphatest” Steam beta (no password required).


RELEASE NOTES

[list]
[*]Supports importing universes from CONSORTIUM VR / Remastered
[*]Updated Main Menu
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the ISS system to be spammed with “Stop fighting” player dialog choices endlessly, preventing the player from saving their game.
[*]All on-screen HUD icons have been disabled for this build.  Reason: it is too cluttered, we think it’s better overall without and will instead be streamlining this system in Alpha 2.0.
[*]Never before seen office complexes and industrial areas around/above/below the C.T.P.F. can now be partially accessed.
[*]More water tunnels have been mapped out and can be accessed.
[*]The parking garage can now technically be reached, but be warned - iDGi-1 signal strength is exceedingly bad down there right now.
[*]Completely removed the functionality of the broken NewsWire panels for now until they have finished content.
[/list]

notes.title: April 21st TOWER dev update
notes.content:
Happy 21 day everyone,

Earth Day is almost here. A day where we celebrate our shared home, planet Earth, and its incredible beauty and diversity. Let's take a moment to appreciate the natural wonders that surround us and commit to nurturing our environment for future generations. Here's to a brighter, healthier, and more eco-friendly world!  

[h2]Consortium: THE TOWER[/h2]

Consortium: THE TOWER remains an active project at iDGi. The Early Access 4.15 build, available on Steam since late 2019, signifies the completion of Phase One of production. While the development process has been lengthy and complex, our original vision for THE TOWER has not changed. Please checkout the following post for more information on our motivations and plans as a company moving forward:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/626250/discussions/0/3829791007686976119/


We are nearing completion of CONSORTIUM VR / Remastered, bringing us closer to commencing Phase Two of Consortium: THE TOWER's production. We have begun integrating the latest CONSORTIUM VR / Remastered features and content into THE TOWER, with plans to release "Alpha 2.0" later this year.

As a result of this effort, Consortium: THE TOWER will now fully support V.R. and V.O.I.C.E. This means that THE TOWER will eventually be coming to Quest and other VR platforms, and the Steam build will soon natively support V.R. (no extra cost to Steam owners).  

The transition between engines UE 4.15 and 4.27 involves significant changes, requiring a substantial amount of time to ensure everything functions correctly. We anticipate that THE TOWER will be released as a UE5 title, but to achieve this, we must first ensure compatibility with UE4 4.27.
Lastly on THE TOWER front, we’d like to share a first glimpse of a choreographed scene in Consortium: THE TOWER, showcasing a little bit of our progress thus far.

[previewyoutube=2dHJwh8B6Bg;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, we have a small surprise for you all... Now that V.O.I.C.E. is "out of the bag", we have decided to make the backer build of THE TOWER available for everyone. That means that anyone can play with the prototype version of V.O.I.C.E. in Consortium: THE TOWER right now. Simply ensure that your Default Mic is on, and you can literally speak dialog lines rather than punch keys.

Namaste,

notes.title: CONSORTIUM VR
notes.content:
Happy 21 day to all!

[h2]CONSORTIUM VR[/h2]

Please free feel to help share the following announce trailer video far and wide across the internet:

[previewyoutube=3jNDhxvc3Ws;full][/previewyoutube]

We will be sharing our Beta to the public via the [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/7197109900314956/ ] Meta Quest 2 [/url] AppLab on February 21st. We are new to VR and want to carefully ease into this brand new market. We aim to ensure that we address all core player concerns during our final polishing rounds.

When CONSORTIUM VR graduates out of Beta later this year, we will be releasing v1.0 right here on Steam: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1428880/CONSORTIUM_VR

The PCVR build will be largely similar to the Quest 2 build, but with the addition of a bunch of graphical options such as volumetric clouds, fully dynamic lights and shadows, amped up particles, etc.

[h2]What about Consortium: THE TOWER?![/h2]

To all of you folks that bought here on Steam that are reading this in frustration: We truly are genuinely sorry that we’ve had to take such a drastic detour from updating Consortium: THE TOWER (The Tower) here on Steam. In exchange for this long wait, future builds of The Tower will be directly receiving many benefits thanks to the CONSORTIUM VR project. This includes features that go beyond what we originally promised backers back in 2016.  This means:

-Full V.O.I.C.E. support. You will be able to use your own voice to conduct dialog in The Tower - zero button pressing.
-Full native V.R support. The Tower will now be coming to VR as well as flat-screen.
-Massively improved combat A.I., FX, inventory systems and general GUI.
-Most of the Virtual Trainer content of CONSORTIUM VR, including the VT editor and mod tools

Finally, if you’re a Steam Tower owner/player that is feeling ignored/abandoned, please hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/idgi]Discord server[/url] and ask for the “Tower Steam Owner” role - you will receive a special icon next to your name and receive special perks and future sneak-preview builds of The Tower, just like Tower backers currently do.

More info about V.O.I.C.E and about CONSORTIUM VR will be coming over the next few weeks.  Until then, it’s back to the dev caves for us!

Namaste,

[h2][b]Whispers From The Rift:[/b] [/h2] We had hoped to be able to publicly release our mobile prequel to CONSORTIUM and Consortium: THE TOWER onto Google Play TODAY, but we’re still –
[list]
[*] Working out some of the kinks with navigating the meta-endings / canon continuation chapters.
[*] Processing quite a few new brain-scan images coming down the pipe. To see another sneak-peek at one of them, hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/Ps6qyRK]Discord server[/url] and take a peek in the Whispers From The Rift channel
[/list] In addition, the [url=https://www.idgi1.ca/whispers-from-the-rift]Whispers From The Rift Website[/url] has received an update. Another closed beta Whispers update is coming within a few days, and the first worldwide free-to-play public release on Google Play will follow shortly afterwards. We also anticipate locking in the release date for Whispers on Steam quite soon.

[h2][b]The VR Game:[/b] [/h2] We now have this running extremely well on the Quest 2 headset now, and there are still more optimizations to make. We are in the midst of prepping what we’re calling a “Pre-Beta Backer Test Build” of the game, with limited-time-only beta test keys to be sent out later this week!  We also have a huge announcement to make for this project, but we can’t say anything publicly until the next 21 day in January…

[h2][b]Consortium: THE TOWER:[/b][/h2] We’ve been attempting to illustrate for a couple years now that our ultimate goal in the grand scheme of things is the completion of THE TOWER.  Just because we have not been updating the public Alpha build of the game doesn’t mean we haven’t been hard at work towards the goal of its completion!

As you will all see for yourself soon enough, our upcoming VR Game is poised to basically become the world’s first interactive cinema experience on the Quest 2. Given [url=https://developer.oculus.com/blog/understanding-the-vr-gaming-market/]market research[/url] by Oculus itself (see “Story Seeker”), all of our practical testing results so far and simply because of the fact that there are NO games even remotely like ours on the platform, we are anticipating great success! We then intend to build a nice completion budget for THE TOWER.

That said, we wanted to leave you folks today with a simple list of all of the stuff [i]already done[/i] and is ultimately coming to a future build of THE TOWER directly because of our VR game project:
[list]
[*]Vastly improved combat AI - combatants now react to incoming fire more realistically, use cover intelligently and use various tactics to try and gain an advantage over players.
[*]Virtual Trainer scenarios will be made available to Tower players, giving access to an all new Combat Training scenario in addition to the basic Consortium Bishop tutorial scenario. 
[*]The Info Console has been completely overhauled with improved functionality.
[*]As mentioned a year ago and elsewhere online, it is still 100% true that the character choreography pipeline we’ve developed with the UE4 engine for the VR Game will be used to bring all of THE TOWER’s cast to life.  
[*]Various improvements to weapons and a vast reworking of all inventory and Consortium Bishop systems (healing, repairing, etc).
[*]A completely rewritten Universe saving system that will allow players to save anywhere.
[*]Consortium: THE TOWER is now going to have an optional VR mode, to maximize immersion.
[/list]
Soon after we’ve shipped both Whispers From The Rift and our VR Game, we aim to be setting our sites back to Consortium: THE TOWER development full-time in 2022, for a possible completion date of v1.0 happening in 2023.

Have any questions, comments or concerns? Join the iDGi Discord community and/or shoot us an email. Until next year, we wish you all a safe, healthy and happy holiday season, and may the New Year bring good tidings for us all…

Namaste,

notes.title: Achievements! Roadmap! Alpha v1.4 Holiday Cheers!
notes.content:
Seasons greetings Interdimensional travellers,

We have just pushed 1.4 live for everyone, just in time for the holidays.  

Most of us have been deep into our various tasks for realizing the content for Act 2, but we’ve still racked up a solid list of fixes and improvements to the overall Act 1 experience based largely, once again, from all of your feedback and reports.    So, thank-you!

Click [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/626250/discussions/0/1496741765128958510/]HERE[/url] for a rundown on all of the stuff we’ve fixed as well as a disclosure of the known issues that we are still working to track down.   The most notable addition is - Act 1 Steam achievements!  There are now 50 achievements that help illustrate just how much story and content is in the game at this time.

The Tower is on sale during the current Winter Sale (21% off on the 21st!). We would like to make a note that this price during the 2017 Winter Sale will be the lowest price The Tower will be offered at for at least a year and probably longer.

[h1]A FEW WORDS FROM US...[/h1]

We’re a tiny developer with a grand vision for what we want The Tower to become when it is finished. This is a work of passion, and its creation comes from a deep belief and vision for what is possible with interactive first-person gameplay, beyond just enabling hyper-addictive and visceral commercial money making products. More than just simple entertainment, we’re striving for The Tower to become a deeply immersive role-playing experience through which one’s imagination is fueled by an interactive ride that will differ for each and every person strapping themselves in.

We’ve recently come to the realization that the Consortium games are, when boiling it all down, about the evils of corporate homogenism and the steady and continued erasure of originality in commercial art and entertainment. In fact, the the entire story and the answers behind all of its mysteries all link to this theme.

By buying our game now, you are supporting our ability to fully realize this vision. Last year, before the Fig campaign, we had no game whatsoever. Instead, we put forth a vision we had for a game in the form of mocked up pre-production videos. A few thousand people reached into their wallets, literally fueling this project's existance.  

So now that it’s playable, the reason for our Early Access foray is to find more gamers that want to see us realize all of the potential for a new kind of single-player narrative game, based on what we’ve managed to create so far. 
 
[h1]THE ROADMAP[/h1]

! SPOILER ALERT !  For those of you who want to be entirely surprised by where you get to go in the Tower and how the game will progress...you might want to avoid looking too closely at the chart linked below.

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30435651/f22193406268e0c579ed55a6262c180ccb884b2f.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30435651/36a9ad491f66de3f2b55d9257732efd9b00b16ad.png[/img][/url]

This chart roughly encapsulates the remaining level work that needs doing to complete the remainder of the game. The colors of the boxes indicate how much work has been done on them so far, and how close they are to being completed. Generally speaking, the darker the blue, the closer they are to completion.

The dark blue boxes are all Act 1, and are currently accessible in the game. Our next big push is to get all of those “almost playable” levels to Early Alpha so we can begin testing them!  Act 3 consists of one big level - the Churchill Tower Power Facility, at the center of the Tower.

So, moving forward, our plan is really quite straightforward:  
[olist]
    [*]We will steadily continue to fix, improve and debug Act 1 gameplay based on ongoing feedback, while simultaneously bringing all of Act 2’s levels to a fully playable state. 
    [*]Once Act 2 is playable, we will be inviting our Earliest Access Fig backers to dive in.  After testing and fixing for awhile with just our closest backers, we will bring Act 2 online here on Steam for even greater testing. The base price will rise at this point, to $29.99.
    [*]Sometime in here we will do another round of voice over recordings for Act 1 and big chunks of Act 2. More robot voices will be replaced by final voices. Principal choreography will also finally begin, with a ton of finalized scenes ready for animations and final character models. Casting of all the remaining characters will be completed by this point.
    [*]Once Act 2 of the game is working here on Steam, we will continue to fix, improve and debug Act 1 and 2 (though Act 1 should be pretty solid by then!). As choreography is completed for Act 1 and 2 scenes, subsequent updates will include those. Meanwhile, after clearing out major Act 2 issues, will will be focussing on realizing the climax of the game, Act 3.   Act 3 is about 10% or less of the total game. It’s the final environment, the final challenge, and it’s where everything culminates.
    [*]Once Act 3 is playable, we will once again invite our most loyal backers to dive in and start testing. This will continue on until reaching BETA. 
    [*]Once the entire game’s story and gameplay are in place, we will then perform a final Voice Over recording pass, allowing for the completion of all of the game’s choreography. 
    [*]Principal choreography is completed, and we officially enter BETA, resulting in a huge update here on Steam.
    [*]Once in BETA, we will be testing the now largely finished game. Final game balancing and bug fixing will occur, with zero new features being added. Once we’ve got the entire game in a solid spot with at least a few months of being in BETA...
    [*]The Game is done! Release V1.0, yay! The game’s price will jump up at this point to its final spot, at $34.99. Ongoing support will continue forth indefinitely from that point, and we have plans to give the community access to our dev tools and integrate the game with Steam Workshop.
[/olist]
In addition, throughout the entire process, we will be steadily polishing and improving the already established core mechanics based on all feedback that we receive.

As far as dates and deadlines are concerned, there are none. The official release date for V1.0 of The Tower is “When It’s Done”. But, as you can hopefully see, we have a concrete plan for the game being “done,” we just feel that quality trumps time restraints.

According to our original minimum budget plan, we have been taking on other jobs at this stage in order to be able to afford to keep developing the project. All this means is that we can't accurately predict WHEN we'll get the game done.   However, the road ahead is about steadily and surely building the required content for the completed narrative based on our now well established mechanics and systems.   We will get there. 

It is a simple fact that the more sci-fi immersive sim fans that discover and buy our game, or [url=https://www.fig.co/campaigns/consortium-the-tower]back us on Fig[/url] to support us, the faster we’ll be able to move through the roadmap. Each and every purchase gives us more of an ability to progress faster through the above steps and to improve the final quality of the game.   

Regardless, we encourage you to look no further than our own company’s history to see how stubborn and determined we are about realizing a Consortium game. Dedication is not something we lack! 

Our first crowdfunding attempt back in 2012 for making the first [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/264240/CONSORTIUM/]CONSORTIUM[/url] (also now on Sale, and you can transfer saves made in it to The Tower for an even deeper story!) didn't work. But we persisted. Our attempt to raise our minimum budget for The Tower on Kickstarter also didn't work. We persisted. Realizing the dream of the Consortium universe is really the ultimate dream. It’s about the dream of us, as humans, being capable of creating a much better world than the one we currently inhabit. Of striving to be much better than we currently are.

It’s about hope. So, on that note...

[h1]HAPPY HOLIDAYS!![/h1]

We invite you all to come say hi on our [url=https://discord.gg/8TgRBxh]Discord server[/url], or to make a post or two on [url=http://interdimensionalgames.com/forum]our Forums[/url]. 

We will leave 2017 with a slogan that we had on a banner on the wall of our Indie MegaBooth at Pax Prime 2014 when showcasing the first Consortium game:

“Consortium: The cradle of utopia -- The fragility of mankind”

Wishing you all a wonderful holiday season, and here’s to a hopeful, prosperous and peaceful 2018 for all of us!

Cheers!!

-- Gregory and the iDGi team

Click [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/626250/discussions/0/1496741765128958510/]HERE[/url] for a rundown on all of the stuff we’ve fixed as well as a disclosure of the known issues that we are still working to track down.   The most notable addition is - Act 1 Steam achievements!  There are now 50 achievements that help illustrate just how much story and content is in the game at this time.

The Tower is on sale during the current Winter Sale (21% off on the 21st!). We would like to make a note that this price during the 2017 Winter Sale will be the lowest price The Tower will be offered at for at least a year and probably longer.

[h1]A FEW WORDS FROM US...[/h1]

We’re a tiny developer with a grand vision for what we want The Tower to become when it is finished. This is a work of passion, and its creation comes from a deep belief and vision for what is possible with interactive first-person gameplay, beyond just enabling hyper-addictive and visceral commercial money making products. More than just simple entertainment, we’re striving for The Tower to become a deeply immersive role-playing experience through which one’s imagination is fueled by an interactive ride that will differ for each and every person strapping themselves in.

We’ve recently come to the realization that the Consortium games are, when boiling it all down, about the evils of corporate homogenism and the steady and continued erasure of originality in commercial art and entertainment. In fact, the the entire story and the answers behind all of its mysteries all link to this theme.

By buying our game now, you are supporting our ability to fully realize this vision. Last year, before the Fig campaign, we had no game whatsoever. Instead, we put forth a vision we had for a game in the form of mocked up pre-production videos. A few thousand people reached into their wallets, literally fueling this project's existance.  

So now that it’s playable, the reason for our Early Access foray is to find more gamers that want to see us realize all of the potential for a new kind of single-player narrative game, based on what we’ve managed to create so far. 
 
[h1]THE ROADMAP[/h1]

! SPOILER ALERT !  For those of you who want to be entirely surprised by where you get to go in the Tower and how the game will progress...you might want to avoid looking too closely at the chart linked below.

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30435651/f22193406268e0c579ed55a6262c180ccb884b2f.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30435651/36a9ad491f66de3f2b55d9257732efd9b00b16ad.png[/img][/url]

This chart roughly encapsulates the remaining level work that needs doing to complete the remainder of the game. The colors of the boxes indicate how much work has been done on them so far, and how close they are to being completed. Generally speaking, the darker the blue, the closer they are to completion.

The dark blue boxes are all Act 1, and are currently accessible in the game. Our next big push is to get all of those “almost playable” levels to Early Alpha so we can begin testing them!  Act 3 consists of one big level - the Churchill Tower Power Facility, at the center of the Tower.

So, moving forward, our plan is really quite straightforward:  
[olist]
    [*]We will steadily continue to fix, improve and debug Act 1 gameplay based on ongoing feedback, while simultaneously bringing all of Act 2’s levels to a fully playable state. 
    [*]Once Act 2 is playable, we will be inviting our Earliest Access Fig backers to dive in.  After testing and fixing for awhile with just our closest backers, we will bring Act 2 online here on Steam for even greater testing. The base price will rise at this point, to $29.99.
    [*]Sometime in here we will do another round of voice over recordings for Act 1 and big chunks of Act 2. More robot voices will be replaced by final voices. Principal choreography will also finally begin, with a ton of finalized scenes ready for animations and final character models. Casting of all the remaining characters will be completed by this point.
    [*]Once Act 2 of the game is working here on Steam, we will continue to fix, improve and debug Act 1 and 2 (though Act 1 should be pretty solid by then!). As choreography is completed for Act 1 and 2 scenes, subsequent updates will include those. Meanwhile, after clearing out major Act 2 issues, will will be focussing on realizing the climax of the game, Act 3.   Act 3 is about 10% or less of the total game. It’s the final environment, the final challenge, and it’s where everything culminates.
    [*]Once Act 3 is playable, we will once again invite our most loyal backers to dive in and start testing. This will continue on until reaching BETA. 
    [*]Once the entire game’s story and gameplay are in place, we will then perform a final Voice Over recording pass, allowing for the completion of all of the game’s choreography. 
    [*]Principal choreography is completed, and we officially enter BETA, resulting in a huge update here on Steam.
    [*]Once in BETA, we will be testing the now largely finished game. Final game balancing and bug fixing will occur, with zero new features being added. Once we’ve got the entire game in a solid spot with at least a few months of being in BETA...
    [*]The Game is done! Release V1.0, yay! The game’s price will jump up at this point to its final spot, at $34.99. Ongoing support will continue forth indefinitely from that point, and we have plans to give the community access to our dev tools and integrate the game with Steam Workshop.
[/olist]
In addition, throughout the entire process, we will be steadily polishing and improving the already established core mechanics based on all feedback that we receive.

As far as dates and deadlines are concerned, there are none. The official release date for V1.0 of The Tower is “When It’s Done”. But, as you can hopefully see, we have a concrete plan for the game being “done,” we just feel that quality trumps time restraints.

According to our original minimum budget plan, we have been taking on other jobs at this stage in order to be able to afford to keep developing the project. All this means is that we can't accurately predict WHEN we'll get the game done.   However, the road ahead is about steadily and surely building the required content for the completed narrative based on our now well established mechanics and systems.   We will get there. 

It is a simple fact that the more sci-fi immersive sim fans that discover and buy our game, or [url=https://www.fig.co/campaigns/consortium-the-tower]back us on Fig[/url] to support us, the faster we’ll be able to move through the roadmap. Each and every purchase gives us more of an ability to progress faster through the above steps and to improve the final quality of the game.   

Regardless, we encourage you to look no further than our own company’s history to see how stubborn and determined we are about realizing a Consortium game. Dedication is not something we lack! 

Our first crowdfunding attempt back in 2012 for making the first [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/264240/CONSORTIUM/]CONSORTIUM[/url] (also now on Sale, and you can transfer saves made in it to The Tower for an even deeper story!) didn't work. But we persisted. Our attempt to raise our minimum budget for The Tower on Kickstarter also didn't work. We persisted. Realizing the dream of the Consortium universe is really the ultimate dream. It’s about the dream of us, as humans, being capable of creating a much better world than the one we currently inhabit. Of striving to be much better than we currently are.

It’s about hope. So, on that note...

[h1]HAPPY HOLIDAYS!![/h1]

We invite you all to come say hi on our [url=https://discord.gg/8TgRBxh]Discord server[/url], or to make a post or two on [url=http://interdimensionalgames.com/forum]our Forums[/url]. 

We will leave 2017 with a slogan that we had on a banner on the wall of our Indie MegaBooth at Pax Prime 2014 when showcasing the first Consortium game:

“Consortium: The cradle of utopia -- The fragility of mankind”

Wishing you all a wonderful holiday season, and here’s to a hopeful, prosperous and peaceful 2018 for all of us!

Cheers!!

-- Gregory and the iDGi team

notes.title: Mini update...
notes.content:
Seasons greetings interdimensional travellers!

This is the first annoucement we've made without a new version having just been uploaded.  

The reason is simple - we're still working on the roadmap and getting things done for EA Alpha v1.4, including new Steam achievements!    We very much want to try and make sure that v1.4 kills as many of the bugs and issues that currently exist in the game as possible, so we're not rushing this one.  There's also been a slight delay on getting the achievements working.  

Speaking of not rushing things... we know many of you are impatient for us to finish this game.  However, it's going to take us as long as it takes.  We're taking our time developing the remainder of the game.  When we do drop the roadmap for you all, it won't include a schedule.  We're not making this game on a schedule, we're realizing our vision of what we want the final game to become, and that's going to take as long as it takes.

Also, after EA Alpha v1.4 releases there will likely be a period where releases will appear to have fewer changes than you've become used to seeing.  They will mostly be fixes and improvements to Act 1 based on continuing feedback from you all, but will eventually include new voice over for things like the hotel mercs, once their lines are finalized.

This is because our tiny team is going to be settling into largely only working on the remainder of the game's levels and content.   This will eventually lead to series of a big "Act 2" update drops to all our "Earliest" access Fig backers, and then here. The rough timeframe for that to start happening is mid-late spring of next year.

In the meantime, there are more Steam achievements for Act 1 of The Tower than there are in the entire first Consortium game, and easily double if not quadruple the amount of total raw gameplay time. 

A reminder - if you want to engage with us and Consortium fans, the best ways are via our iDGi [url=https://discord.gg/8TgRBxh]Discord channel[/url] and [url=http://interdimensionalgames.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=157]forums[/url]

One final note:  I've started [url=https://www.twitch.tv/idgi_1]twitch streaming[/url] again, and will probably continue to do more.  The next time I start a stream I will be sure to post an announcement here on Steam!

Until next time!

Sincerely,

Gregory and iDGi team

notes.title: Alpha v1.3 just went live...
notes.content:
Greetings stalwart seekers, travellers and interdimensional explorers:

More bugfixing, optimizing and polishing is to be had in the latest.  A huge number of the fixes and updates were made possible because of YOUR playtesting reports and Discord messages, so thank-you!

There is now a definitive "ending" of sorts to the experience currently live on Steam.  Find an iDGi-1 connection tunnel and walk to the end to trigger it.  It's a little taste of things to come...

Also of note, an experimental "grab object" button to  allow you to pick up physics objects. 

To take a look at the complete list of changes, go  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/626250/discussions/0/1496741765128958510/]HERE[/url].

[h1]What to watch for in the next update[/h1]

--Game completion roadmap:  I realize we said we would have it ready by now, but unfortunately it's just not ready yet.  We've been furiously working on it, however.  It is getting close.  We want to make sure that it is extremely accurate, so we're taking our time.

--One other thing you can look forward to in the next update - ~50 Steam achievements are in the process of being created and setup to be triggered in game!  There's a LOT that can be done in the current game - more than we think most folks realize.  The upcoming achievements will hopefully highlight this for everyone.

[h1]Contact us![/h1]

A reminder - the absolute best place to post any issues you may encounter in game is [url=http://interdimensionalgames.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=157&t=1401]HERE[/url].  

There's also our [url=https://discord.gg/8TgRBxh]Discord server[/url]  if you wish to chat with us directly!  

We absolutely love any and all feedback.  Please drop by and say hi!

Well, it's back to the development caves for us.

Until next time,

Gregory and the iDGi crew
